summary: Iteration 22 — Group training discount price + cart/checkout for groups, discount codes targeting groups, course sale_closed + waitlist. Backend: 8/8 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration22.py. Admin PUT /api/admin/group-trainings/<id> persists discount_price; public GET /api/group-trainings/<slug> returns discount_price=3999 and effective_price=3999 (price 4999). POST /api/admin/discounts accepts group_ids and /payments/validate-discount restricts correctly (group-only code applies to group items, 400 on course-only cart). POST /api/payments/checkout with items=[{group_id}] + 100% group code produces status=free with order.items[0].group_id, price=effective_price (3999); _enroll_free immediately creates group_enrollments. Repeat checkout returns 400 'zaten kayıtlısınız'. Transfer checkout with group followed by POST /api/admin/payments/<order_id>/mark-paid enrolls user into group via enroll_group_item branch. POST /api/courses/<id>/notify validates email format (400 on invalid), dedupes via upsert (one waitlist row for duplicate submit), and GET /api/admin/courses/<id>/waitlist returns it. Checkout with sale_closed=true course returns 400. Regression: normal course free checkout still works. Restore step verified group discount_price and course sale_closed returned to original. Frontend: Desktop group detail with discount shows group-original-price='4.999 ₺' (strikethrough), group-price-display='3.999 ₺', group-discount-badge='%20 indirim'; group-schedule renders between the Google Meet strip and the Eğitim Hakkında/Outcomes blocks (verified by rect top ordering). group-add-to-cart clicks and switches state. Mobile 390px: group-mobile-bar shows group-mobile-price + group-mobile-discount-badge, scrollWidth==clientWidth (no overflow). /canli-grup-egitimleri list page renders strike + discounted price for the group card. Course sale_closed: /kurslar list shows 'Yakında satışta'; /kurslar/<slug> shows course-sale-closed-box with course-notify-email + course-notify-submit → course-notify-done after submit; mobile mobile-notify-btn visible and no 390px overflow. All state mutations fully restored after test run.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_payments._apply_discount correctly supports both course_ids and group_ids restrictions and bases discount only on matching items — matches spec.
routes_payments.checkout enforces sale_closed=400 for courses, already-enrolled/capacity-full=400 for groups, and _enroll_free handles both course and group items — complete.

routes_admin.mark_paid now branches on it.group_id and calls enroll_group_item for cart-based group orders (kind absent) — correct. Note: the elif kind=='group' branch (direct purchase_group PayTR orders with top-level group_id) remains for backward compatibility; both paths covered.
routes_payments.paytr_callback also handles cart items via its final `if not is_consulting and kind != 'group'` loop which includes it.get('group_id') → enroll_group_item. Good.

routes_courses.course_notify uses upsert with $setOnInsert for dedupe — ideal; however {'is_published': True} filter in find_one means notify fails (404) for unpublished-but-sale_closed courses. Current spec says 'courses can be published but sale closed' so this is fine, but worth noting if a draft course needs waitlist pre-launch.
routes_group._public returns both discount_price and effective_price via group_price helper — frontend GroupDetail and GroupCard rely on this; verified in UI.

GroupDetail.jsx places Eğitim Takvimi section inside the content column, immediately after the meet strip and before the Eğitim Hakkında/outcomes blocks — matches request #4. Verified via DOM top-position ordering.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (desktop+mobile group discount UI, schedule ordering, course sale_closed box + notify flow, course list 'Yakında satışta', no mobile overflow)

The ui_test_notify@example.com waitlist entry from UI test and stale TEST_ users from previous iterations were also wiped. All deleted in test_zz_restore_and_cleanup + post-UI cleanup; group grp_741a4764d948.discount_price restored to None, course_8b53eae5576a.sale_closed restored to False (verified via GET).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group grp_741a4764d948 (slug google-ads-canli-grup-egitimi) is the canonical test fixture; course_8b53eae5576a (slug google-ads-ile-sifirdan-uzmanliga) is the canonical course. Both have their original state (no group discount, sale_closed=false). PayTR is NOT configured so /payments/checkout with payment_method='paytr' returns 503 — tests use 'transfer' or 100% discount→free path. Guest checkout lowercases email in users collection so any lookup must use email.lower(). To test discount UI, set group.discount_price via PUT /api/admin/group-trainings/<id> then restore to None. To test sale_closed UI, set course.sale_closed=true via PUT and restore.
